reviews.review: This is the best thing to happen to coop shooters since Left 4 Dead. It's worth it even in EA and it's going to get better.

This game is great. It is so fun dropping into the world and digging through the environments, fighting hordes of arachnid aliens, while mining through the world searching for loot. This game is totally worth it, even at full price.

-Rock and Stone!

Dwarves, Mining, Big Bugs, Bigger Guns, and MOST Importantly Beer!!!!!!! What more can you ask for?!?

All goofiness aside this game is a wonderful example of a Coop gameplay. Each class has unique solutions to the various challenges you will face on missions but only through working with the other classes do they really shine. On the development side GSG is very transparent and responsive to their community. I bought the game not to long after it went into early access and I feel like I have gotten way more than I have paid for with the wonderful content that continues to be added. If you are on the fence about buying this game don't be it is worth the money and if you already own the game consider showing the devs some love and pick up the supporters pack.

There is something really special about this game. It's incredibly fun, even after maxing out all of the character levels. It presents a very simple and easy-to-grasp form of gameplay: mine the ores, kill the aliens, get home safe, and each of the classes in the game feels unique and fun to play. One of my favorite selling points of the multiplayer in this game is that each class offers something unique and helpful, but if your team is missing one of them you can still do just fine. Everybody can go the same class and it all works out. The meta is very flexible and you can play however you like and still be successful (most of the time). 

It's charming, fun, and offers endless replayability with its procedurally generated levels. I love this game.
Highly recommend. Rock and stone, brother!
